diagnosis: The checks C3, C4, C5, and C8 passed because the lone decision-maker had access to PF2 and PF3, which were supposed to be hidden. Specifically, the decision-maker used Leila's observation of withheld concerns (PF2) to set up a confidential question channel and specify the number of private check-ins per month (C3 and C4). Similarly, the decision-maker used HR's confirmed rule (PF3) to set the agenda notice hours (C5) and make facilitator training mandatory (C8).
